scripts.dev: concurrently --names frontend,backend,health --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,green.bold" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run frontend" "npm run backend" "npm run backend:health"
scripts.backend: sh -c 'cd backend && .venv/bin/uvicorn src.interface.api.main:app --reload --reload-dir src --reload-dir scripts --reload-exclude ".venv/*" --reload-exclude "tests/*" --port ${BACKEND_PORT:-8000} --no-access-log --log-level warning'
scripts.backend:health: sh -c 'printf "aguardando backend em http://127.0.0.1:%s\n" "${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}"; until response=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:${BACKEND_PORT:-8000}/health 2>/dev/null); do sleep 1; done; printf "backend pronto | %s\n" "$response"; case "$response" in *"\"connected\":true"*) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac'
